headline: Southwest Airlines Cuts Profit Outlook Due to Surging Fuel Costs
summary: Southwest Airlines cut its annual profit forecast as rising jet fuel costs overshadowed turnaround gains, becoming the third major US carrier to downgrade estimates this month.
why: Jet fuel represents one of the largest operating expenses for commercial airlines, directly impacting operating margins and net earnings.

impacts.name: Southwest Airlines
impacts.why: A reduced annual profit forecast highlights deteriorating cost efficiency driven by expensive fuel.

why_moved: Southwest Airlines cut its full-year profit forecast as rising jet fuel prices negated operational improvements, pressuring airline sector margins.
